title: Saqqa e Haram Rakhlena Bharam
body:
YA BAABE HAWAIJ YA MOLA x2
<<DIVIDER>>
SAQQA E HARAM RAKHLE NA BHARAM HUM DAR PE TUMHARE AAYE HAY
TUM BHI NAHI HUM KO TUKHRANA X2 HUM DUNIYA KE TUKHRAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
AB SAARE SAHARE TOOT CHUKE HUME APNE PARAYE LOOT CHUKE X2
TUM APNI PANAHO MEI LELO HUM RAN SE BHOT GHABRAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
MOLA TUM BAABE HAWAIJ HO ROZE PE UNHE BHI BULWALO X2
GHURBAT KE SABAB JO AA NA SAKE HAM UNKE AREEZE LAAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
AB QABR SE PAANI LIPTA HAY SAQQA E SAKINA PYASA HAY X2
AB HASHR TALAK DARIYA SAARE DENE KO SALAAMI AAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
IK JAANIB ROZA TUMHARA HAY SHABIR KA ROZA EK TARAF X2
BAINUL HARAMAN AAKAR HUMNE DAMAN APNE PHELAAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
KYA AP PE AAKA GUZRI THI KUCH KAHIYE MUSIBAT APNI BHI X2
BIN HAATHO KE KAISE LEHRA KAR GHORE SE ZAMEEN PAR AAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAHRA KE LAAL KA PYASA GALLA GARDAN KI PUSHT SE KATTA GAYA X2
KHANJAR KI HAR IK ZARBAT PAR YEH ARZ O SAMAA THARRAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
EK QABR HAY SHAAM KE ZINDAAN MEI EK MASHQ ABHI TAK KHAALI HAY X2
HUM PYASI SAKINA KI KHATIR AANKHO MEI AANSU LAAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
DARBAAR SAKHI ABBAS KA THA KUCH MAANGNA THA LAAZIM MAANGA X2
LEKIN YEH HAQIQAT BHI HAI QAMAR HAM PURSA DENE AAYE HAY
<<DIVIDER>>
SAQQAE HARAM…
